purpose: Disease-matched label references for a single-photo research prototype; not per-plant prescriptions.

references.source_title: PPQS product label, English leaflet page 12
conditions: The label rate is per hectare; its water ratio is not a validated dose for one plant.
Check the purchased product label, local suitability, crop stage and application history before use.
The leaflet describes use before/mid tillering and at flowering; it excludes crop maturity and immediately before harvest.
Do not combine with insecticides or plant growth regulators. Follow the full leaflet's weather, protection, re-entry and harvest restrictions.
